name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
description: The AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC) is a benchmark dataset of 7,787 genuine grade-school science multiple-choice questions (Grades 3 through 9). Developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2), the dataset is split into an Easy Set (5,197 questions) and a Challenge Set (2,590 questions). The Challenge Set contains questions that both search-based retrieval models and word co-occurrence algorithms answer incorrectly, requiring genuine reasoning and common-sense knowledge.

name: Stanford Question Answering Dataset 2.0 (SQuAD 2.0)
description: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD) 2.0 combines the 100,000 questions in SQuAD 1.1 with over 50,000 unanswerable questions written adversarially by crowdworkers to look similar to answerable ones. To do well on SQuAD 2.0, systems must not only answer questions when possible, but also determine when no answer is supported by the paragraph and abstain from answering.

name: UltraChat 200k (Filtered Dialogue Dataset)
description: UltraChat 200k is a heavily filtered and curated subset of UltraChat, an open-source multi-turn instruction dataset designed for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of conversational language models. Created by Hugging Face H4, it refines the original 1.4 million dialogues down to approximately 208k high-quality multi-turn conversations across questions about the world, creative writing, problem solving, and programming. It served as a foundational alignment dataset for models such as Zephyr-7B.
